key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上及び株主還元の充実

summary_en: 4,000,000 shares (9.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired at up to ¥1,000M aggregate via open-market purchase on TSE from 10 August 2026 through 30 June 2027. Executed to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
summary_jp: 発行済株式（自己株式除く）の9.3%にあたる400万株を、最大10億円で2026年8月10日～2027年6月30日に東証市場買付で取得。資本効率向上と株主還元充実を目的。
